domain: dense f64 inverse, one CPU call, same pivot/nonfinite contract

baselines.name: current full Gauss-Jordan shared kernel
baselines.basis: Calculated from two full n-column multiply/subtract loops per non-pivot row per pivot, not measured runtime.

decision_points.name: elimination schedule
decision_points.current_choice: Gauss-Jordan updates work and inverse for every nonpivot row

alternatives.choice: forward elimination below pivot, then back substitution of inverse rows
alternatives.analytic_basis: Old pairs=2*n^2*(n-1)=33423360; proposed work pairs=sum(j^2,j=0..n-1) plus inverse pairs=n^2*(n-1)=22271360. Both maintain work and result matrices, no additional workspace; leading flops 4*n^3 -> (8/3)*n^3.
alternatives.reported_effect: unmeasured wall time; calculated scalar pair reduction only
alternatives.transferability_note: n256 count excludes pivots, divisions, loads, stores and branches; cannot imply CPU/GPU latency, RSS, or framework speedup. Same precision and errors must pass all route oracles.
alternatives.falsifying_experiment: Instrument loop pair counts for n1,2,3,16,256; reject count derivation on mismatch. Run unchanged pivot/scaled/singular/nonfinite/both-side residual and823 exact certificates on4routes; benchmark separately before any wall-time claim.
